description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for calendar events in an Android application using Room persistence library. It provides methods for retrieving, inserting, updating, and deleting calendar event entities in the database.

classes.name: CalendarEventDao
classes.description: Interface acting as a Data Access Object for calendar events, annotated with @Dao, providing methods to query and modify calendar event data in the database.

methods.name: getAllEvents
methods.description: Retrieves all calendar events as a Flow stream of a list of CalendarEventEntity objects.

methods.name: getEventsForPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves calendar events within a specific date range, returning a Flow stream of a list of CalendarEventEntity objects.

methods.name: getEventsModifiedAfter
methods.description: Suspending function that retrieves a list of events modified after a given timestamp.

methods.name: insertEvent
methods.description: Suspending function to insert a new calendar event into the database, replacing on conflict.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Suspending function to update an existing calendar event.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Suspending function to delete a specified calendar event.
